title: pavonia poeppigii
intro: Pavonia poeppigii, commonly known as the Mexican rose mallow, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Pavonia poeppigii include its anti-inflammatory and antitussive properties, which help in soothing irritated tissues and relieving coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
